SMALL BY DESIGN.

Intelligence, with
a smaller footprint.

Picobot is an experiment in making AI small enough to live in your browser, and useful enough to be part of your everyday.

We’re building a tiny language model, with local tools and memory, to explore how much is possible when the intelligence stays with you.

Made by @farilyaz.
